color.$description: A cool iris over a slate ramp: frosted alpha surfaces, hairline light borders, and an iris primary that stays legible through the blur.

primary.$description: The iris: primary actions, links, focus rings.

secondary.$description: Deep slate: secondary actions and highlights.

accent.$description: Glacial cyan: supporting emphasis, distinct from primary.

semantic.$description: Status colors. Named by meaning, never by hue.

surface.$description: The page: a light mist the glass floats over.

surface-sunken.$description: Recessed wells and stripes: mist one step deeper.

surface-raised.$description: The frosted pane: cards, popovers, menus read through it.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text: captions, helper copy, placeholders.

border.$description: The hairline of light every pane edges with.

scrim.$description: What dims the page behind a modal: the night water itself, so the blur has something to frost.

link.$description: Links read against body text, so they follow the primary.

field.$description: A field's own pane: frosted, so a control reads as glass set into glass.

border-strong.$description: A control's own edge: the brightest hairline, so a field reads at a glance.

on-semantic-error.$description: Text on the matching fill. A fill with no foreground cannot be read, which is what this token prevents.

on-danger.$description: The legacy name for the ink on the error fill. It points at `color.on-semantic-error` — the role the contract requires, the floor is measured on, and the danger button and the danger badge wear — so the two names can never disagree.

on-semantic-info.$description: Text on the matching fill. A fill with no foreground cannot be read, which is what this token prevents.

disabled.$description: The fill a dead control wears: the ramp one step off the page.

font.$description: Typography: which face, how large, how heavy, and how open the tracking sits.

heading.$description: The display face. Glass answers with the grotesk; a theme with a serif voice states its own.

body.$description: The body face. Distinct from `sans` only when a theme wants the two to differ.

brand.$description: The display face — one cool grotesk, every glass surface.

display.$description: Display — the largest statement on the page. Hero headings (h1 reads it). Not section titles (that's title).

title.$description: Title — the section title. h2 and stat figures read it. Not subsections (that's heading).

heading.$description: Heading — the subsection title. h3 reads it. Not UI labels (that's label).

subtitle.$description: Subtitle — the large UI step. Large buttons (button s-lg falls back to it). Not intro paragraphs (that's lead).

lead.$description: Lead — the intro paragraph. Article ledes and empty-state subheads. Not default reading text (that's body).

body.$description: Body — the default reading text. Every paragraph. Not UI labels (that's label), not emphasis (that's body-emphasized).

quote.$description: Quote — somebody else's words (blockquote reads it). Not default reading text (that's body).

code.$description: Code — identifiers and paths (code reads it). Monospace. Not prose of any kind.

label.$description: Label — the short named thing. Field labels, card headers, badges (badge falls back to it). Not annotations (that's caption).

caption.$description: Caption — the annotation. Timestamps, helper text, stat context. Not named emphasis (that's caption-emphasized).

overline.$description: Overline — the kicker above a title (h5/h6 read it). Tracked out. Not a label (that's label).

body-emphasized.$description: Body, emphasized — definition terms (dt reads it). Same tuple as body except the semibold step. Not a second family (see the variant convention).

caption-emphasized.$description: Caption, emphasized — figcaptions and table headers (figcaption, th read it). Same tuple as caption except the semibold step.

$description: Translucency-first glass: frosted alpha surfaces, hairline light borders, backdrop-blur depth, and layered soft shadows — a cool slate iris over light mist and night water.

surface.$description: Optical frost across translucent containers and controls.

blur.$description: Backdrop blur radius softening content behind frosted glass panes.

button.$description: Component tokens: the decisions a theme owns for its buttons. Glass buttons are frosted panes with a hairline of light, lifting deeper into the blur on hover.

edge.$description: The hairline of light the button edges with.

shadow.$description: The resting elevation: a soft lift under the frost.

shadow-hover.$description: The hovered elevation: the pane rises deeper into the blur.

radius.$description: The corner rounding of a button.

card.$description: The card's own decisions: frosted pane, generous air, hairline light edge, and layered depth.

radius.$description: A slow corner: glass rounds like water, not like paper.

padding.$description: The air inside the card, between its parts and around its edge.

border.$description: The hairline of light the card edges with.

elevation.$description: The resting depth: layered soft shadow under the frost.

badge.$description: Component tokens: the decisions a theme owns for its badges. A frosted pill with a hairline edge.

edge.$description: No drawn edge: the frost and the pill shape hold the badge apart from the page.

pill.$description: Fully round reads as a pill; false squares it into a tag.
